name: Coco Nkrumah
title: Counsellor
description: I work with men navigating dating stress, relationship breakdown, anger, anxiety, sexual frustration, low confidence and uncertainty around masculinity. My approach is practical, respectful and direct.

name: Kim Bailey
title: Psychotherapist, Family Therapist
description: As humans we are biologically hard-wired to form strong, close connections. Good relationships keep our brain at high function, reduce stress even physical pain.

name: Alexina Baldini
title: Psychologist, Clinical Supervisor
description: Alexina assists individuals and organisations to realise their true potential through the provision of innovative clinical, consultative, and training services. My aim is to translate psychological knowledge and research into exemplary service delivery that realises potential by: creating opportunities for personal growth and development, encouraging positive personal and workplace relationships, developing opportunities for company growth and diversity. I am passionate about empowering individuals and families to live the life they dream of and particularly specialise in trauma recovery, forensic and workplace arenas and child, adolescent and family interests.

name: Penelope Lovegrove
title: Psychologist, Counsellor
description: Penelope is an accredited psychologist and experienced therapist who has worked with individuals of varying ages across a range of concerns. She is passionate about the practice of psychotherapy as a powerful tool for emotional healing and personal growth. Penelope has undertaken additional training in CBT, ACT, Internal Family Systems, Schema Therapy, Solution Focused and Compassion-Focused Therapy.

name: Emma Schubert
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Hi there, I’m Emma. I am a clinical psychologist working with both children and adults.

name: Dr Arthur Stabolidis
title: Clinical Psychologist, Psychotherapist
description: I adopt a compassionate and empathic forward-focused approach to therapy. I believe that cultivating empathy for yourself and others, the ability to regulate emotions, and a robust stress management routine are essential elements in personal, social and career success.

name: Adam Szmerling
title: Psychotherapist, Social Worker AMHSW
description: I believe most of our adult struggles are covert (or not so secret) enactments from our early childhood experiences which were inadequately processed. Part of this problematic processing comes from our immaturity as children, especially in the face of trauma or even new, difficult encounters, all of which have effects that leave marks, traces and unconscious criteria through which we use to select partners in love and work. His main approach is Lacanian psychoanalytic psychotherapy, and he also draws on schema therapy and Buddhist psychotherapy.

name: Dr Loretta Bell
title: Clinical Psychologist, Relationship Therapist
description: I like to work in a collaborative process in which therapy fits the person or couple I am seeing. I work integratively from a wealth of theories and counselling modalities that I have mastered over my years as a therapist. I am also training in schema therapy and Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR).
specialties: PTSD, Trauma Recovery, EMDR, Schema Therapy, Trauma-Informed
